compatibility.api: API 1.3.0 keeps this component version: Bitcoin direct payment changes no public HTTP catalog route, schema or behavior. The buyer's /api/btc-invoice endpoint is not part of the public catalog API.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 keeps this component version: its four anonymous read-only tools and schemas are unchanged. The Bitcoin confirm, refund, push-check and release tools belong to the seller's local operator MCP server, not the public catalog MCP.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.3.1 is a packaging patch: public methods and types are unchanged, while the bundled release metadata now identifies the Bitcoin release. Both compatibility packages are 0.3.1 and pin exactly @namegarage/sdk 0.3.1. Published 0.3.0 archives remain immutable.
compatibility.skill: Skill 1.3.1 updates the exact SDK install pin to 0.3.1 and the coordinated release metadata. Public read-only guidance and the MIT-0 license remain unchanged; published 1.3.0 bytes remain immutable.
compatibility.a2a: A2A 1.0.0 keeps this component version: no transport, admission or skill change.
compatibility.website: Website 1.2.1 keeps its functional version: catalog files, snapshots and public read contracts retain their behavior. Agent install examples advance to verified SDK 0.3.1 only after coordinated publication. The direct-purchase panel offers Bitcoin and hides Gram payment details after payment, cancellation or an unreadable state; the buyer invoice endpoints are outside the public catalog API.
compatibility.ucp: Adapter 1.0.0 keeps this component version: UCP catalog search, lookup and permalinks are unchanged.
